title: Targets and Gridiron (Diptych)
description: Gallery view of two framed collage works displayed side by side. Left panel features dense overlapping targets, concentric rings, and an american football amid yellow and orange gestural marks; right panel presents a muted industrial composition with a central football, vertical yellow stripes, and target motifs on grey and brown ground.
composition: two framed works displayed side by side
keywords: industrial grey collage with football motif
